exposure: Surfactant administration via Less Invasive Surfactant Administration (LISA) using an infant feeding tube
outcome: Need for repeat dose of surfactant
cohort: 150 preterm infants between 26 and 34 weeks of gestation with RDS requiring surfactant therapy
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the primary outcome of total duration of respiratory support between the LISA and InSurE groups.
birth_weight: Not specified, but baseline characteristics including birth weight were similar between groups
